title: STF.-----PROJ.DY
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 223 (T(IMP)M-21). STF (source transfer) is the subject; PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment), PRI-INFO (principle information) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From IST-S-ALGN: RE-ST (restructuralism) and RT-DY (reality dynamics). From PRI-INFO: LG-DY (logical dynamics). From PROG-CONT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From RT-DY: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From LG-DY: MOT-DY. From T-C-IMP: INFO-INTG (information integration).
